name: m1-desktop
description: M1 for macOS: a window onto the M1 that runs on this computer.
author: Mincoffical

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: M1 listens when you talk to it in voice chat or dictate a message.
extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: M1 looks through the camera only when you turn it on in voice chat.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: M1 can control other apps when you ask it to.
